review.covers: #3277 S5 T5: with the live chain's bootstrap row merged into the base (gate at height 3, inside the fixture), the committed determinism fixture replays byte-identically to expected_roots.json before and after the gate opens and across a restart at the gate: zero extensions move no state root (RED control: folding the extension section unconditionally).
Applying blocks beyond MAX_REORG_DEPTH cannot advance raw BFT finality; only the explicit finality-signal arm may advance it.

#3301: boot installs the protocol gate from durable block 1 BEFORE loading state; a V1 chain whose block 1 schedules paymaster at 3 with a Stake at 4 in the WAL tail fails to load in the old order (load then gate) and reproduces the producer's tip state_root through gate_then_load_state; plus a source pin that launch_api main.rs loads state only through gate_then_load_state, with the real gate (assert_startup_protocol_compatibility, install_uncut_chain_protocol, archive_empty_but_height_recorded) in the closure.

#3301 F2: the checkpointed / snapshot-synced boot shape in its own process: checkpoint at 2, WAL tail 3..6 across a paymaster activation at 3 with a Stake at 4, block 1 the durable lowest block; load-before-gate fails, gate_then_load_state reproduces the producer's tip state_root.
Dev endpoint modules and routes are compiled out unless dev-endpoints is enabled, shipping build profiles leave the feature off, and the documented surface remains classified disabled-in-release.

The launch_api envelope redacts internal errors: every leak class in a detail string is reduced to the public class and a correlation id in body, headers and status; a source-level pin that no INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR envelope in routes/ bypasses envelope_redacted.

#3361 F2: the faucet-sink binding across its activation H_F, through restart (mid-run-up and after H_F), IBD from genesis, replay_verify, snapshot join (before and after H_F), and the clean halt of a binary without the ConsensusFeature variant at H_F-1 (refusing to boot at tip >= H_F). Own process (process-wide schedule/authority/overlay).
The pinned three-host testnet producer roster resolves to the genesis committee, producer authority is enforced per member, and no placeholder key or payout address can reach a real cut.

DNS-rebinding, Host and Origin validation runs from the real headers before any handler: a refused request never reaches its handler, a wildcard cannot be configured, CORS never reflects, and the admin set matches the surface document.

#3332: replay_verify replays under the effective feature schedule (base plus applied #3277 extensions), refreshing it on the genesis anchor and after every applied block like the node: an extension in the genesis anchor (Stake in block 1) and one applied by block 3 (Stake at 3 + MIN_RUNUP_BLOCKS) both put AccountAuthorizationDispatch in force, the SmartAccount-declared Stake is refused as the producer refused it, and every committed root verifies; removing either refresh diverges at the Stake height (RED).

#3277 S3 T2: an applied schedule extension naming a feature this binary lacks installs the #3093 clean-halt deadline at its activation (refuse H, run through H-1, boot refused at tip >= H); a known feature installs none and activates; the deadline only ever tightens, including across a reorg that drops the extension.

#3277 S6 + #3361 F4: GET /network/upgrade (real handler, real AppState) reports the effective feature schedule with per-entry source (genesis / bootstrap-shaped base row / extension seq N), known flags, run-up warnings for an unknown pending entry inside RUN_UP_BLOCKS and the installed #3093 halt deadline, plus the faucet sink {address, source, active_from} (binding on 777 after activation, none before, genesis address wins); a node restarted from its checkpoint and one that installed a snapshot report identical scheduled/faucet_sink objects; the body carries no bearer token or signer key (RED on main: no scheduled object). Runs in a child process: included launch_api unit tests share the binary and the schedule globals are process-wide.

#3361 F1: on a 777 chain with no genesis faucet and faucet_sink_binding scheduled at H_F through the extension overlay, the real producer, the P2P applier (extract_transitions) and WAL replay from genesis agree on state_root, emission ledger and faucet balance at H_F-1, H_F and H_F+1; the bound wallet is unpaid at H_F-1 and paid exactly the faucet slice from H_F (RED on main: producer faucet spend 0 at H_F). Runs in a child process: the included extractor unit tests share the binary and the overlay is process-wide.

#3290: forecaster_key_binding (unschedulable) scheduled at H through the extension overlay. The issue's random-key probe is admitted, mined and registered with the gate off; from H it is refused at mempool admission (with a height and, once scheduled, without one), a block carrying it fails verify_block, and the real producer drops one admitted against a stale tip; a commit accepted below H is revealed after H (grandfathering); producer, P2P applier (extract_transitions) and WAL replay agree on state_root, pending commits and reveals at H-1, H and H+1 (RED: removing the classifier or the admission check fails it). Runs in a child process: the included extractor unit tests share the binary and the overlay is process-wide.

#3277 S4: POST /transactions/governance/schedule-extensions is operator-only, refuses by admission policy (unknown / not-schedulable names) and by full V1-V9 validity at the node's next height with the named reason (too-soon activation, wrong sequence, no signatures), admits a valid extension to the mempool and reports its latest valid carrying height, and refuses a duplicate; nothing is admitted on any refusal. Own process (process-wide gate and authority).

#3277 S5 F1: a source scan over shared-protocol, native-chain and the CLI proves install_schedule_extension_authority_from_block1 has exactly one production caller (native-chain/src/upgrade.rs), the test-only constructor appears in production code only as its own cfg(any(test, feature = test-support)) definition, and the unrestricted installer is gone.

#3277 S5, core4#3368 review P2-1/P3-2: on a PERSISTED chain whose block 1 is the live chain's, upgrade::arm_block1_protocol_at_boot (the launch_api boot gate) installs the base schedule with the bootstrap (schedule_extension at H_ENABLE) and the pinned authority; a block-1 storage error, an empty archive, or a lowest block that is not block 1 refuses boot and installs nothing (fail-closed). Each scenario in its own re-exec child.

#3277 S5, review P3-3: on a fresh node (provisional base, no authority) the shared block-1 hook, taken by IBD/P2P join, snapshot join and a self-mined block 1, re-resolves the base WITH the live chain's bootstrap and installs the pinned authority; a source pin shows every node path (boot gate, P2P apply, mining, snapshot install before its state install, replay_verify) reaches the block-1 inputs, and that the hook installs the authority before its provisional check.

#3277 S4: replay_verify (production entry point, no observer) replays a chain whose schedule extension rides in block 3 as a real FeatureScheduleExtension transaction: extraction applies it, the overlay refresh puts AccountAuthorizationDispatch in force at 3 + MIN_RUNUP_BLOCKS, the SmartAccount-declared Stake at that activation is refused as the producer refused it, and every committed root verifies; a discrimination guard shows the Stake extracts under the base schedule alone.

#3277 S3: a restart replays each WAL block under the effective feature schedule (block-1 base plus extensions applied before it): an extension carried in the WAL tail (per-block refresh) and one in the checkpoint anchor (anchor refresh) both put a later paymaster Stake in force and reproduce the producer state_root; plain load_state fails (RED); launch_api refreshes from the restored state after the #3093 genesis deadline and refuses boot at tip >= activation.

#3270 option B through the real State::apply_transition with the reference node's h21101-h21108 header timestamps, one re-exec child per leg: no schedule (live) rejects the halt backlog with the exact logged error and writes nothing (the carried timestamp is inert); scheduled before the pre-halt reading accepts the backlog, records the accepting block's header time as root material, and still rejects a 10-day-future reading; scheduled after it falls back to the block-count rule.

#3270 S9 replay_verify leg: a persisted chain of real weather commit/reveal transactions with the reference node's halt header gaps (7 blocks, 30h) is produced under weather_skew_block_time_allowance, then a fresh process running the production replay_persisted_chain (no observer, nothing pre-installed) arms the schedule from the chain's own block 1 (#3277 S5), re-extracts every block with its header time and verifies every root; the same blocks with a block 1 that does not stamp the schedule diverge exactly at the first accepted reading (discrimination).

Every InternalError variant converts to a public shape that leaks nothing: for each ErrorKind, a detail carrying paths, versions, host names, store fragments and secret-name segments yields a static public message plus a correlation id, and the redaction scanner finds no leak class in the output.

Realized mints across coinbase, gamification, contribution, and authorized attester paths stay within each block's ADR-003 partition through reduction, terminal, deferred-backlog, producer, P2P, and WAL-replay cases.

Every `#[cfg(feature = "...")]` in shared-protocol names a feature declared in [features]. An undeclared gate is always false, so the code it guards is never compiled, type-checked or tested while still reading as a shipped capability (the #2316 data_hub and #2975 governance defects).

Consensus feature-activation schedule parsed from genesis metadata; asserts a feature scheduled at height H flips on producer, applier and replay surfaces at exactly H and moves no state root (finishes #1396).

A governance-signed epoch-2 OracleRegistration batch seating a 4th oracle with quorum 2, mined above height 1 on a chain whose genesis declared N=3/K=2: producer, follower and from-genesis re-sync converge on one state root; 2-of-4 attestations pay and 1-of-4 does not (deferred, not wedged, at live heights); replayed registrations are evicted and refused by the epoch rule; the low-quality override quorum stays 3 and the reward quorum stays 2; a quorum-3 batch pays nothing with two live attesters.

#3277 F4: a node booted on an empty volume re-resolves its base feature schedule from the synced block 1 exactly once, so consensus stops depending on the cut-time WRFCOIN_GENESIS_ACTIVATION_SCHEDULE; own process because it installs the process-wide base.

#3277 S3: effective feature schedule = base (genesis) plus applied extensions refreshed from canonical State; replace-not-merge on refresh, the base always wins a name, first-unknown reporting, and T3 at schedule level (a branch-only extension changes no feature_active answer within MAX_REORG_DEPTH of the fork).

#3277 S4: the FeatureScheduleExtension transaction end to end: T4 V1-V9 each with an accept and a reject case through the stateful block path (verify_launch_state_invariants), tampered chain/genesis/sequence/name/height/version/commit fields, a replayed tx and an UpgradeNotice signature presented as an extension's all rejected; verify_block rejects an unparsable payload; T8: the mempool refuses unknown and not-schedulable names while the same tx in a block is valid and applies; the producer includes an admitted extension only once the gate is active, in sequence order. Own process (process-wide gate and authority).

#3361 F3: on the chain whose block 1 is the LEGACY_FAUCET_BINDINGS row's hash, the mempool admits and the producer includes the faucet_sink_binding extension (E0f); a faucet_sink_binding* name without a row stays refused there, yet a block carrying it is valid and applies (T8). Own process (process-wide gate and authority).

#3277 S5 F1: a block 1 hashing to the live 777/testnet genesis installs the base schedule WITH the bootstrap row (schedule_extension at H_ENABLE) and an authority built only from the bootstrap row identity and the D1 pin; a re-cut chain reusing 777/testnet (another block 1) gets neither, so every extension fails closed. The re-cut case runs in a child process.

#3361 F1: faucet_sink_binding scheduled at H_F through the extension overlay pays the owner-bound 777 faucet wallet exactly its slice from H_F through the real ApplyFaucetReward arm (account created, fully spendable, once per block); a genesis-recorded sink always wins; a non-777 chain is never paid; the mint is min(slice, MAX_SUPPLY headroom) at both sides of the first reduction and zero where emission is zero (RED on main: nothing minted).

#3214: unscheduled ConsensusFeature::StationOwnerSlashIdentity scheduled at H in-test only; below H a data-quality violation keeps the pre-#3214 station_id trigger and debits nobody, at H the trigger binds the registered wrf/0x owner and finalization burns exactly 30 units with reputation and cooldown effects, and an unregistered station fails closed.

Weather reward tier: widened NWS pressure band and second-worst-variable fold pinned against the built-in bands — a station good on most metrics is no longer tiered Outlier (0.1x) by one borderline metric; two wrong variables still tier Outlier; the 2026-09-11 KDLH residuals tier Good.

Generated prototype forecast keys are written private and never printed; key files with permissions wider than 0600 are refused before use with errors that hide key material; environment-supplied keys and --help disclose no secrets.

Actual prototype executable: chain-bound next-height feature view, signed persistence-RMSE strategy and byte-identical feature-off artifacts; malformed feature view and aggregate score overflow stop transaction publication.

Gate-OFF baseline for the Stake/Unstake consensus prerequisite: KNOWN-DEFECT goldens for the replayed Stake that locks twice with nonce 0 and the producer root differing from the peer root, with fixed-clock state roots and block hashes. Calls the historical extractor/apply/finalization seam directly (not mempool admission, gossip or a node runtime).

Native-vs-circuit correctness equivalence for range, confidential-transfer, selective-disclosure and weather circuits: each circuit accepts and rejects exactly what the native check does (including the #819 selective-disclosure attack), and canonical constraint counts cannot drop silently.
Option C S1 unscheduled feature registration, known-feature pairing and deterministic refusal OFF and ON.
/state/snapshot summary root streamed: same root and count as the full build, peak allocation bounded below the block window, with a held-window RED control.
Gate-OFF report submissions refuse without changing serialized state or root bytes; fixture roots and block hashes match unchanged main staking goldens.

#![cfg(feature = "docker-tests")]; Docker-based WRF execution harness, same host-permission gap as basic_docker (core4#2893).
#![cfg(feature = "docker-tests")]; DockerRunner::new() against the Docker daemon, same host-permission gap as basic_docker (core4#2893).

zero_test_exceptions.reason: Deliberately test-free by design (see the target's own doc comment): a compile-drift shim wiring tests/stress/'s standalone async HTTP load-test drivers into `cargo check --workspace` so they don't rot silently. Those drivers run against a live node at WRFCOIN_TEST_API_URL and are intentionally excluded from `cargo test` -- see tests/stress/README.md for how to run them manually. Zero #[test] functions is the intended, reviewed state, not a coverage gap.

2 real #[test] functions, both #[ignore]d BY DESIGN -- verified against the issue that made it so, not assumed: core4#2748 (closed) reported this target as reporting PASSED when HSM_TEST_ENABLED != 1 (a skipped HSM test indistinguishable from a verified one); core4#2876 (merged 2026-08-31) fixed it to skip HONESTLY -- #[ignore] plus a --min-executed companion gate, so a default run reports a countable "0 passed; 0 failed; 2 ignored" instead of a silent pass, and fails loudly if run without an HSM. Not runnable in CI without a provisioned softhsm2 token (docs/operator/hsm.md); run manually with -- --ignored.

1 real #[test], #[ignore]d BY DESIGN from its very first commit -- verified via `git log --follow`, not assumed: 1c72725b7 (2026-05-20, core4#1613, now closed) added this as "a live-gated ignored integration test scaffold", commit message stating the intent explicitly ("normal cargo test shows the test ignored, and --ignored without WRF_TEST_PEER_ADDR returns a skip-success"). Not a regression -- it has never run by default. Requires a live testnet peer; run manually with WRF_TEST_PEER_ADDR set and -- --ignored.

1 real #[test], #[ignore]d BY DESIGN from its very first commit -- verified via `git log --follow`, not assumed: e7e06a6ef (2026-05-22, PR #1670, "YubiKey 5 PKCS#11 client support") introduced this file already carrying #[ignore], with its own doc comment explaining why ("never runs without the operator opting in"). Not a regression -- it has never run by default. Requires a physical YubiKey 5 (docs/hsm/yubikey.md); opt in with WRFCOIN_HSM_TEST_YUBIKEY=1 -- --ignored.
